VsCodeTaskButtons.tasks.label: $(play) Dev
VsCodeTaskButtons.tasks.tooltip: npm run dev — stop from that terminal’s trash can, or Tasks: Terminate Task

VsCodeTaskButtons.tasks.label: $(server-process) Worker
VsCodeTaskButtons.tasks.tooltip: npm run dev:worker — stop from that terminal’s trash can, or Tasks: Terminate Task

VsCodeTaskButtons.tasks.label: $(rocket) Deploy game
VsCodeTaskButtons.tasks.tooltip: npm run deploy -- the live player-facing app

VsCodeTaskButtons.tasks.label: $(cloud-upload) Deploy authoring
VsCodeTaskButtons.tasks.tooltip: npm run mcp:hosted:deploy — Cloudflare authoring Worker, not the stdio MCP

VsCodeTaskButtons.tasks.label: $(flame) Monster Mash
VsCodeTaskButtons.tasks.tooltip: npm run test:all -- everything, including the slow layout-quality searches (~15 min)

VsCodeTaskButtons.tasks.label: $(graph) Content stats
VsCodeTaskButtons.tasks.tooltip: npm run content:stats -- which schema features are actually used across the puzzle collection

VsCodeTaskButtons.tasks.label: $(key) Admin
VsCodeTaskButtons.tasks.tooltip: npm run admin -- local game with &admin (starts server if needed)

VsCodeTaskButtons.tasks.label: $(cloud-download) Import layout
VsCodeTaskButtons.tasks.tooltip: npm run import:star-layout -- pick a layout JSON exported from Author Layout and save it as a curated Star override
